Real oracle text (data/fin/fin_scryfall.json #81): "Job select (When this Equipment enters, create a 1/1 colorless Hero creature token, then attach this to it.)\nEquipped creature gets +1/+1, has \"Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw a card,\" and is a Rogue in addition to its other types.\nEquip {4}". Mana cost {2}{U}, type line "Artifact — Equipment" — both verified against fin_scryfall.json, unchanged from the pre-existing definition.ts. Real Forge citation: thiefs_knife.txt (../mtg-forge) — ONE static ability, `S:Mode$ Continuous | Affected$ Creature.EquippedBy | AddPower$ 1 | AddToughness$ 1 | AddType$ Rogue | AddTrigger$ TrigDmg | ...`.

Unlike the other 6 cards in this family, ENGINE_GAPS.md gap #14's own P/T-bonus+type-grant follow-up closure (2026-09-12, same day) meant `continuousPTGrants`/`continuousTypeGrants` were real, executable machinery from the START of this migration, not a residual inert clause to leave text-only — so `definition.ts` gained both fields directly (`continuousPTGrants: [{power:1, toughness:1, includeSelf:false, equippedBySelf:true}]`, `continuousTypeGrants: [{types:['Rogue'], includeSelf:false, equippedBySelf:true}]`), same shared `qualifiesForContinuousGrant` mechanism dragoon-s-lance/crystal-fragments-summon-alexander already establish.

**Went further than every sibling in this family, deliberately, per explicit task instruction**: rather than leaving these two facts real-mechanism-but-inert (the `isEquippedPTGrantFact`/`isEquippedTypeGrantFact` shape-scoped exemption every other sibling in this batch relies on, since their own `scenarios.ts` are plain `harness.ts` Scenario[] arrays with no manual-log-injection field), this card's `scenarios.ts` was migrated to a real `engine-trace.ts` pilot (same style crystal-fragments-summon-alexander already established for its own pump-only analogue) — the FIRST card in this family to get real evidence for BOTH grants, and the first ever to exercise `verify-synergy.mjs`'s own `hasSubtypeReadEvidence` check (wired in the gap #14 pass, never exercised by a real card until now). Real story: cast Thief's Knife -> Job select fires (manually, via `pilotFireTrigger` — `Trigger.on` is unset for this named ETB, same as every sibling's own onEnter, so no auto-fire mechanism recognizes it) -> creates the 1/1 Hero token, auto-attaches -> a real `read:getNetPower`/`read:hasSubtype` pair proves the Hero genuinely recalculates to a live 2/2 Rogue the instant it's equipped -> real Equip {4} activation re-attaches Thief's Knife onto Qiqirn Merchant (a real, already-on-the-battlefield FIN creature, not invented filler; `chooseTarget`'s own real pool[0] default picks it, since it was placed on the battlefield before the Hero token existed) -> a second real read pair proves the grant genuinely FOLLOWS the live re-equip: the Hero drops back to 1/1 non-Rogue, Qiqirn Merchant picks up +1/+1 (to 2/5) and Rogue -> the granted "whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw a card" fires (manually, same `onEquippedDealsDamage`-as-self simplification buster-sword/genji-glove/this card's own pre-migration draft already establish — no auto-fire mechanism for a combat-damage trigger exists in engine.ts either), a real `drawCard` line.

**Real bug found+fixed along the way**: the first draft of this scenario called `pilotActivate` for the Equip {4} ability with no follow-up `pilotResolveTop` — an activated ability goes on the stack (602.1) same as a spell, so the re-equip never actually happened (silently: `canActivateAbility`/`activateAbility` both reported success, since the ABILITY resolving onto the stack is itself legal; the custom effect's own `actions.equip` call just never ran yet). Caught by inspecting the regenerated trace.json directly (the second `read:getNetPower`/`read:hasSubtype` pair still showed the Hero, unchanged, not Qiqirn Merchant) rather than assuming success from `run-scenarios.mjs`'s own clean exit — fixed by adding the missing `pilotResolveTop(pilot)` call, matching crystal-fragments-summon-alexander's own identical activate+resolveTop pairing for its {5}{W}{W} transform ability.

**Real second bug found+fixed in verify-synergy.mjs itself, not just this card's own authoring**: `isEquippedPTGrantFact`/`isEquippedTypeGrantFact`'s own doc comments claimed a future card with real trace evidence would be recognized automatically ("hasKeywordReadEvidence/hasSubtypeReadEvidence is checked FIRST") — false. Traced the actual loop order: both shape-scoped exemptions' own `continue` fires BEFORE `hasSubtypeReadEvidence`/the `pump`-case `producedEvents` branch are ever computed, so a real card's own real evidence is silently exempted away (never actually evaluated) unless it's ALSO excluded from the exemption by name — confirmed the hard way (Thief's Knife's own real `read:getNetPower`/`read:hasSubtype` lines were invisible to the check until `card.name !== "Thief's Knife"` was added to both functions, mirroring the pre-existing `card.name !== 'Crystal Fragments'` exclusion `isEquippedPTGrantFact` already had for the identical reason). Both doc comments corrected in place to record the real mechanism rather than the untested claim.

Facts (7 total: 6 source, 1 sink) — self-cast (`{event:'cast', from:'Hand', target:'self'}`, typeLine-anchored), self-enters (`{event:'entersBattlefield', to:'Battlefield', subject:'self', target:'self'}`, typeLine-anchored), Job-select token-creation (`{event:'entersBattlefield', to:'Battlefield', controller:'you', subject:{token:'c_1_1_hero'}, value:1}`, oracle-anchored), pump (`{event:'pump', power:1, toughness:1, target:{equippedBySelf:true}}`, oracle-anchored, REAL evidence), grantType (`{event:'grantType', type:'Rogue', target:{equippedBySelf:true}}`, oracle-anchored, REAL evidence — first in the pool), granted drawCard (`{event:'drawCard', controller:'you'}`, oracle-anchored, REAL evidence via the manually-fired `onEquippedDealsDamage` trigger), and the standard Equip sink (`{to:'Battlefield', controller:'you', types:{has:['Creature']}}`, oracle-anchored, same shape every sibling Equipment's own Equip ability establishes). `annotations-authoring.json` added (7 entries, positionally aligned), baked via `compute-annotations.mjs`; `thief-s-knife` added to `scripts/annotation-coverage.mjs`'s `ANNOTATED_CARD_SLUGS`.

knownGaps: The Job select auto-attach ('...then attach this to it') and the Equip {4} activated ability's own attach action are both real, executed (actions.equip), but carry no Fact/event vocabulary — 'equip' stays on verify-synergy.mjs's PARKED_ACTION_FNS list pool-wide (no card in the corpus wants an 'equip' event today); only the token-creation half of Job select and the equip sink's own 'wants a creature to attach to' half are represented as Facts.

The granted "whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw a card" is modeled via the established onEquippedDealsDamage-as-self simplification (buster-sword/genji-glove precedent) — real, executable, real trace evidence, but still a simplification: the actual trigger condition (the EQUIPPED creature dealing combat damage to a player) is never itself detected by engine.ts (no automatic combat-damage-to-player trigger dispatch exists anywhere in this engine, checked); a pilot script fires it manually, same as the Job select ETB.
